title: graveyard instance configuration
description: Everything specific to one village. The engine ships with neutral defaults; only owner is required.

owner.description: Login of the GitHub organisation or user whose repos make up the village. The type is detected via the API unless ownerType is set.

ownerType.description: Forces the owner type instead of detecting it (one request less per run).

includeForks.description: Include forked repos. Default: true for organisations, false for users.

org.description: Deprecated name of owner; implies ownerType "org". Still accepted. If both are set they must be equal.

language.description: Language of the interface (engine/locales/<language>.json) and default for epitaphs.language. Default: en.

mark.description: Small word mark above the title (header, loading screen, login, brass sign). Default: owner.

title.description: Title of the village. Default: the title of the locale ("Graveyard of Repos" in English).

team.description: Playable characters by id. Without a team there is one neutral guest figure.

mourners.description: Non-player characters who comment on repos. Without members the inscriptions have no mourner field.

label.description: Group name shown before "Trauergast" in the UI.

promptGroup.description: Phrase naming the group in the inscription prompt.

language.description: Language of the prompt template (server/pipeline/prompts/<language>.js). Default: language.

project.description: The whole phrase the prompt uses for project and organisation, e.g. "\"graveyard\", the night-time village where the repositories of Example Org live and rest". Default: built from context.

context.description: Who the village belongs to, as one phrase; only used when project is not set. Default: owner.

model.description: Anthropic model id. Default: a small Haiku model.

exclude.description: Repos that never appear anywhere (collecting, inscriptions, world).

clients.description: Client display names by slug (topic graveyard-client-<slug>). Otherwise derived from the slug.

familyColors.description: Window light tint by repo name prefix.

aliases.description: Commit author name (lower case) -> display name.

bots.description: Extra regular expressions for bot accounts to leave out.

auth.description: Sign-in. Without a provider the village is public.

label.description: Provider name on the login button.

storage.description: upstash: multiplayer, shared counters and refresh on open (in-memory during local development). none: static world from data/.

deadDays.description: Days without a push until a repo is dead. Default 90.

aliveDays.description: Days without a push while a repo still counts as alive. Default 30.

zombiePauseDays.description: Pause after which new commits count as a resurrection. Default 90.

graveTiers.description: [commits below, tier] in ascending order; above the last: mausoleum.

look.description: Appearance of the model figure (colours as #rrggbb).

photo.description: Path relative to the config file.

logins.description: Local parts of sign-in e-mails that play this character. Default: [id].

prompt.description: Role description for the inscription prompt. Default: role.
